tools.name: get_market_metadata
tools.description: Get metadata for active tweet/post-count markets (elon, cruz, or trump). No authentication required. FREE counts are ~5 min delayed. Returns market IDs, questions, and counters.

tools.name: get_trading_signals
tools.description: Get EV-based trading signals for tweet/post-count markets (elon, cruz, or trump) with Kelly criterion sizing. Requires PRO tier API key or x402. Use when you need actionable trading recommendations.

tools.name: get_crypto_metadata
tools.description: Get metadata for crypto markets. No authentication required. Returns market IDs and basic crypto market info.

tools.name: get_recent_tweets
tools.description: Get recent posts for elon/cruz (X tweets) or trump (Truth Social). FREE tier limited to 15, is_counted hidden. PRO or x402: up to 100 with is_counted.

tools.name: get_predictions
tools.description: Get predictions for active tweet/post-count markets (elon, cruz, or trump). FREE: delayed counters + market prices. PRO / x402: live forecast percentiles and edge.

tools.name: analyze_portfolio
tools.description: Analyze a wallet's positions with EV-based recommendations. Requires PRO tier API key. Use for portfolio optimization and position analysis.

tools.name: get_rebalancing_recommendations
tools.description: Get rebalancing recommendations for a wallet's positions. Requires PRO tier API key. Use when you need to adjust existing positions based on new signals.

tools.name: check_health
tools.description: Check Polystrike API health status. No authentication required. Use for debugging or verifying API availability.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_market_metadata, get_trading_signals, get_recent_tweets, get_predictions · Private data: get_trading_signals, analyze_portfolio, get_rebalancing_recommendations · Public sink: get_market_metadata, get_trading_signals, get_predictions.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_market_metadata, get_trading_signals, get_recent_tweets, get_predictions · Private data: get_trading_signals, analyze_portfolio, get_rebalancing_recommendations · Public sink: get_market_metadata, get_trading_signals, get_predictions

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_market_metadata" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Get metadata for active Elon tweet markets. No authentication required. Returns market IDs, questions, and basic info." → after: "Get metadata for active tweet/post-count markets (elon, cruz, or trump). No authentication required. FREE counts are ~5 min delayed. Returns market IDs, questions, and counters."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
